decisions.statement: A reader carrying a contributor is read to the person naming that contributor.
A reader carrying no contributor is read as the reader nobody signed in as.
A reader reads a page type only where that reader's person holds an access naming it.
A session no person holds reads no page type.
A person's accesses are held for a few seconds, so one roster is one reading.
An access carrying a narrow lets its holder read and never write.

definition: whether the reader a site read may read a page type
